archive_encoding: Deterministic gzip and tar; raw member bytes retained; no extraction is required for verification.

historical-qualification.tar.gz.role: Earlier source-bound execution, diagnostic failures and initial incoming checks; final acceptance must use the qualification receipt rather than sum every run.

converter-qualification.tar.gz.role: Synthetic carrier files, actual converter output, strict route outcomes and numbering control; isolated application profile excluded.

runtime-provenance.tar.gz.role: Pinned runtime and locked-dependency integrity, resolution output and documented disk pruning; runtime binaries and package cache excluded.

final-qualification.tar.gz.role: Accepted final cohorts, explicit retained-source proofs, final intake and main supplements, exact commands and reproducible audit scripts; failed and superseded Mail/format attempts are retained but excluded from passing totals.
